shard.name: Fabric
shard.description: Fabric is a lightweight, experimental modding toolchain for Minecraft with fast load times and minimal performance impact.
shard.author: FabricMC & Midnight Team
shard.installScript:
#!/bin/bash
# Fabric Server Installation Script for Midnight Panel
set -e
apk add --no-cache curl jq

cd /mnt/server

if [ -z "${MINECRAFT_VERSION}" ] || [ "${MINECRAFT_VERSION}" == "latest" ]; then
    echo "Resolving latest Minecraft game version..."
    MINECRAFT_VERSION=$(curl -s https://meta.fabricmc.net/v2/versions/game | jq -r '.[0].version')
fi

if [ -z "${FABRIC_LOADER_VERSION}" ] || [ "${FABRIC_LOADER_VERSION}" == "latest" ]; then
    echo "Resolving latest Fabric loader version..."
    FABRIC_LOADER_VERSION=$(curl -s https://meta.fabricmc.net/v2/versions/loader | jq -r '.[0].version')
fi

if [ -z "${INSTALLER_VERSION}" ] || [ "${INSTALLER_VERSION}" == "latest" ]; then
    echo "Resolving latest Fabric installer version..."
    INSTALLER_VERSION=$(curl -s https://meta.fabricmc.net/v2/versions/installer | jq -r '.[0].version')
fi

echo "Installing Fabric (Minecraft: ${MINECRAFT_VERSION}, Loader: ${FABRIC_LOADER_VERSION}, Installer: ${INSTALLER_VERSION})..."

DOWNLOAD_URL="https://meta.fabricmc.net/v2/versions/loader/${MINECRAFT_VERSION}/${FABRIC_LOADER_VERSION}/${INSTALLER_VERSION}/server/jar"
echo "Downloading prebuilt server jar from ${DOWNLOAD_URL}..."
curl -o "${SERVER_JARFILE}" -fSL "${DOWNLOAD_URL}"

echo "Writing eula.txt..."
echo "eula=true" > eula.txt

echo "Fabric installation complete!"

variables.name: Server Jar File
variables.description: The name of the executable jar file to run Fabric.
